notes.title: DE:VOID Update Log v1.2.0 [Added Korean Language]
notes.notes:
Hello friends! 
Thank you for playing DE:VOID. It really means a lot to us, and the feedback we've got so far have been amazing.

This time, we're announcing a big update in the form of version 1.2.0. From now on, DE:VOID will support Korean language! Our biggest thanks to Kim Doe and his friend, for their dedicated contribution in translating this game to Korean. You guys are awesome! With this additional language support, we hope DE:VOID can be enjoyed by more people in the world.

If you own DE:VOID and can't find the new language option, please follow these steps to enable it:
1. Go to your DE:VOID installation folder in steamapps/common/DEVOID/www/save
2. Disable your Steam Clouud and delete it as well.
3. Delete save files 2 and 3.

We apologize for the inconvenience. However, if you buy DE:VOID after v1.2.0 you will not need to do these steps.

Oh, and one more thing. In a few weeks, we will launch the Store Page for our next game! We've been working on it for a while (even before DE:VOID) and we promise it'll be interesting, so please be excited!
We hope you enjoy this update, and thank you again for your continuous support!

notes.title: DE:VOID Road to Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have great news for you guys. Finally, the development of DE:VOID has been finished!
Creating DE:VOID was quite a long and arduous task, especially because this game contains several non-linear elements. You can play this game in different ways and you will uncover various mysteries along the journey.

Currently, we are entering testing and polishing phase. You can see from the screenshots below that we’ve made some improvements visually. What do you think? Looks better, doesn’t it?

https://i.imgur.com/h8eu8E2.png

https://i.imgur.com/ZRSYBFN.png

Anyway, If you wanna keep tracking us, please join on our Discord.

So, We hope you enjoy the updates we’ve communicated so far. We’re preparing a new trailer and we aim to announce a solid release date by the next update!

Please be excited! 
Thank you for your continuous support!
